scope: Independent static review and adversarial CPU fixtures; no model, CUDA API or GPU launch

findings.finding: The admission helper ignores the resource plan's BLOCKED_ORIGINAL_THREAD_UNVERIFIED status. A self-reported fresh boolean plus unverified thread evidence can produce ADMITTED even while the frozen plan blocks execution.
findings.required_resolution: Keep blocked plans blocked; bind any future live release to validated current-thread/device/source receipts and explicit timestamp/window limits. The preparation helper is not a resource arbiter.

findings.finding: Actual count fields permit fractional numbers; a model_requests value of 0.5 was persisted.
findings.required_resolution: Require integer counts for requests, rows, launches and capture bytes, retaining finite nonnegative seconds as the only real-valued resource.

findings.finding: Actual usage above reservation raises before recording the actual cost. The attempt remains RESERVED with null actual usage, losing the observed overrun in the ledger.
findings.required_resolution: Retain actual usage and an explicit budget-violation terminal record; reject all subsequent reservations. No refunds or automatic retries.

findings.finding: The initial validator trusts producer-declared requested_rows and vocab_size. A self-consistent record can omit requested rows or shrink vocabulary size without binding to the independent request contract.
findings.required_resolution: Require independent expected requested row IDs and expected vocabulary size. The qualification agent accepted this finding and is implementing the fix.

findings.finding: The initial metadata recipe accepts arbitrary GPU-prefixed UUIDs with SM120 rather than binding the actual authorized device.
findings.required_resolution: Require an externally frozen authorized device UUID. The qualification agent accepted this finding and is implementing the fix.

findings.finding: The reviewed helper does not acquire a process-bound exclusive lock, enforce one three-hour wall-clock window, monitor actual launches, or stop its own worker on budget expiry. No live launcher is claimed or available.
findings.required_resolution: Implement and qualify those controls before future GPU admission; current preparation remains zero GPU.

findings.component: original execution-thread and actual loaded modules
findings.finding: Original-thread liveness is unverified because the app thread-list connector failed. Historical disk pins and an empty nvidia-smi process list cannot establish duplicate-work clearance or newly loaded DLL identities.
findings.required_resolution: Retain INCONCLUSIVE and the blocked GPU gate until fresh evidence is available.

findings.finding: The recovered operand is an explicitly derived q8 replay from a real q32 capture. Historical A/B q8 outputs agree, but this is not a new actual q8 projection capture and does not qualify C.
findings.required_resolution: Use only as a labeled CPU/build fixture. Obtain a true admitted q8 capture before the main native A/B/C comparison.

final_recheck.live_runner_readiness: PREPARATION_ONLY; original thread, exclusive lock, wall-clock window and worker monitoring remain unqualified
